title: Size of openings.
officialText:
The net free area of each opening, calculated in accordance with Section 708, shall be a minimum of 1
square inch per 1,000 Btu/h (2201 mm2/kW) of input rating of the fuel-burning appliances drawing combustion, ventilation, and
dilution air from the communicating spaces and shall be not less than 100 square inches (64 516 mm2).
SECTION MC 703
OUTDOOR AIR
